answer: The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a gale seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. The sonnet receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. A pre-written answer bank as a result goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 40 aliases trips the duplicate check at the comet gate. Collateral of 160 dollars is at risk. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
